description: This file defines an internal class 'RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder' that implements 'IProviderBuilder<ISiloBuilder>' to configure Redis-based grain directory provider within Orleans Silo building process. It registers providers via assembly attributes and configures Redis connection options either by a service key or connection string.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryProviderBuilder
classes.description: Internal sealed class implementing 'IProviderBuilder<ISiloBuilder>' to set up Redis grain directory provider for Orleans Silo.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder with Redis grain directory options based on configuration section, choosing between service key or connection string approach.
